author: Michael McLaughlin
title: Neighbors' express concerns about roofing company after repairs - NewsBreak
text:
By Michael McLaughlin ,
56 minutes ago
SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — Thousands in Springfield are seeking repairs for damaged property after last month’s historic hailstorms, with some claiming suspicious activity by repair companies.
Randy Craig, a retired Navy veteran living with disability, said a company came offering to make repairs to his roof. They estimated $800 to fix the leaks and replace his roof vents.
Craig said little to no work was done.
“They were up there for 10 or 15 minutes, I heard clanking and I looked out, they already had their ladder down and was on their truck,” Craig said. “So I put my ladder up, climbed up there and they didn’t move any of the brush on the other leaks, they pounded on one little spot and said they were done.”
They then requested money.
“They wanted $800,” said Craig. “I said, I’m not paying you $800 for nothing. What we agreed to, you haven’t done. They said, ‘have a good day’ and left.”
His neighbor, Jon Law, also got his roof worked on by the same company. He paid them $800, then later found that the only work that had been done was two tarps nailed onto his roof. He had to call another contractor to finish the job.
“I was angry, but I had agreed to it, so I had to pay it,” said Law, “I didn’t do my due diligence by getting stuff in writing and making sure that they were going to come back and finish what they started.”
Ozarks First reached out to JC Roofing and Exteriors, the company in question. When first asked about Craig’s roof, a spokesperson said that he “wasn’t happy with how much work was done for what was quoted.” In the law’s case, they say it was a “handshake agreement” and were planning to come back, but were told that the law was going with another company.
The Better Business Bureau (BBB) stated that while they can’t comment on this particular business, they advise people to first contact their insurance provider and check the company’s business profile on the BBB website.
